name: Lodging — Waldorf / Clinton / Brandywine, Nov 25–28 (must host dinner for ~12)
notes: Search done 2026-09-04 across Airbnb, VRBO, Booking/Expedia mirrors. Party: 2 adults + 3 teens. Must-have: physical space to seat ~12 for dinner (mixed seating OK — table + island/breakfast area; buffet-style lower priority). Secondary: host allows gatherings. Options are ordered best-fit first. Every 'no parties or events' rule is Airbnb boilerplate; message the host and describe it as a family Thanksgiving dinner with ~7 day visitors before booking. Prices are Airbnb/VRBO totals for 3 nights incl. fees as displayed on 2026-09-04.

options.title: Charlotte's Manor in Noire — 5BR farm stay (Brandywine)
options.notes: BEST FIT. Dining photos: true formal dining room, table with 6–8 chairs, china cabinets, plus adjacent sunroom with its own table = easy 12 across two rooms. HOUSE RULES: no 'no parties/events' clause at all (only quiet hours 11 PM–8 AM, no smoking). Host also rents an on-site event barn, so a 12-person dinner should be a non-issue. Only 4 reviews (all 5 stars). Brandywine proper.

options.title: Spacious 5BR w/ in-ground pool, poker room & arcade (Waldorf) — VRBO
options.notes: HOST EXPLICITLY ALLOWS EVENTS — VRBO house rules: 'Events allowed: family gatherings, birthday parties, weddings.' A review describes hosting a kids' birthday sleepover there. Dining: open-plan great room with a dining table (~6) plus a second game/dining table and kitchen island — mixed seating for 12 is realistic, buffet-style easy. Min renter age 29. 10/10 on VRBO but only 2 reviews. Full refund until Oct 26.

options.title: Lux DC Metro Home w/ Theater & Game Room — 6BR (Accokeek)
options.notes: Dining photo: large formal dining room, table seats 6 as set with room to add leaves/chairs; description says 'kitchen and sunroom area large enough for family gatherings.' Best-reviewed big house on the list (4.93/44). RULES: no parties/events; 'only registered guests allowed'; 'unregistered visitors must be approved' — so ask the host before booking. 25+ to book. Quiet hours 10 PM–8 AM.

options.title: Linville Manor — 1852 estate, 4BR (Upper Marlboro)
options.location: Upper Marlboro, MD (~15–20 min from Clinton/Brandywine)
options.notes: Most beautiful dining room in the set: large formal dining room photographed set for 8, chandelier, plus a lounge and a ballroom — 12 at dinner is trivial physically. RULES: 'larger gatherings are prohibited unless approved by host; guest will pay additional fees if approved' — i.e., there IS an approval path, just ask. Overnight max 8 (fine for 5). Some photo captions say 'shared kitchen' / 'shared backyard' — confirm with host that the house is exclusively yours. Price shown ~$461/nt before fees; $2,364 total as displayed.

options.title: Escape to Middleton's Farm — 4BR farmhouse (Waldorf)
options.notes: Best value with a real dining room. Description: 'formal dining room that is able to accommodate 8+ adults'; photo shows a dining room with table for 6 (leaves likely) opening to a living room. 12 would need table + overflow in the den/living room. RULES: no parties or events, quiet hours 11 PM–7 AM, no pets. 4 queen beds only. Only 4 reviews.

options.title: Family Friendly Home near MGM — new 2026 5BR/5BA (Fort Washington)
options.location: Fort Washington, MD (~15 min from Clinton)
options.notes: Biggest, newest house. Photos show very large open living areas (multiple sectionals) and a kitchen island with stools, but NO dining-table photo — the 'formal dining room' in the description is unverified; ask host for a photo. Buffet-style for 12 would be easy here. RULES: no parties/events; quiet hours 9 PM–8 AM; 'neighbor complaints can result in eviction.' Price was discounted from $2,869.

options.title: Spacious 5BR w/ parking near DC, sleeps 12 (Waldorf)
options.notes: Dining photos: proper dining room with a table set for 6 (tray ceiling, chandelier), open to living room; second kitchen table area. Mixed seating for 12 plausible. RULES: no parties/events; 'no unauthorized guests stay overnight' (daytime visitors not explicitly banned); 25+ unless pre-approved. Beds are mostly singles (3 rooms with 1 single each).

options.title: Modern Farmhouse | Lux 4BR on 2 acres (Waldorf) — also on VRBO
amenities: Deck + patio w/ propane fire pit
options.notes: Well-reviewed (4.83/119). Dining photo: table for 6 open to the living room; captions say 'plenty of outdoor space on the 2 acre lot to host small events (check with us on special event pricing)' — host is event-tolerant, but Nov is cold for outdoor overflow. Airbnb rules: no parties/events, quiet 11 PM–10 AM. VRBO listing 3569066 for the same house is $2,622 and says 'No events allowed.' Ask host directly.

options.title: Spacious Modern Home near National Harbor & MGM — 4BR (Fort Washington)
options.location: Fort Washington, MD (~15 min from Clinton)
options.notes: Good value. Dining photos: bright dining room with a 6-seat table plus a separate 4-seat breakfast nook = 10 seated, more on the sofas. RULES: no parties/events; quiet hours 10 PM–6 AM; no extra visitor language. Beds include 2 bunk beds.

options.title: Charming 4-bedroom house w/ pool, central Waldorf — VRBO
options.notes: HOST ALLOWS EVENTS on VRBO ('family gatherings, birthday parties, weddings'), but the dining space is modest: small table (4–6) plus a counter with stools; two living rooms for overflow. Buffet-style 12 OK, seated 12 not. Zero reviews yet — new listing. 4 double beds.

options.title: Spacious 4BR near DC, sleeps 11 (Waldorf)
amenities: Dining area (table for 6, 'built for big group dinners')
Fully stocked kitchen w/ ice machine
options.notes: Cleanest house rules of any Airbnb here: just '11 guests maximum' — NO no-parties clause, no visitor clause. Dining photo: 6-seat table in a tiled dining room; host markets it for family reunions. Would need extra chairs/overflow for 12. Book-early discount from $1,997.

options.title: 5 Bedroom Family Home Near Nation's Capital (Clinton)
options.notes: Only Clinton-proper whole home available, cheapest option, most reviews (206). Dining photo: modest dining room, 6-seat table + stools, pass-through to a small kitchen — tight for 12 seated. RULES: 'unregistered guests (family, relatives, friends) are not allowed on the premises without prior approval from the host' — must ask first. 'Rare find' banner; usually booked.

options.title: Cheerful 4 bedroom home with fireplace (Waldorf)
options.notes: Dining room (6 + bench) plus an eat-in kitchen table (4) = ~10 seated. Max occupancy is exactly 5 (your party). RULES: no parties, no loud music; no explicit visitor ban. Lower rating (4.72). Garage/basement locked.

options.title: Wooded Hillside Retreat near DC — 5BR (Waldorf) [UNAVAILABLE]
options.notes: Would have been a top pick — 'dining room comfortably accommodates large groups' (photo: 8-seat table w/ bench), 3,600 sq ft — but NOT available Nov 25–28 on Airbnb or VRBO. Also caps visitors at 6 at a time. Keep an eye on it in case dates open.

options.title: Luxury Mansion near DC — events allowed (Brandywine) [UNAVAILABLE]
options.notes: Explicitly allows events (up to 45–50 guests, $1,500 flat fee) but NOT available Nov 25–28.

options.title: Captain's Luxury Pool House Retreat (Fort Washington) [UNAVAILABLE]
options.notes: Real dining room w/ chandelier, 9.8/10 (23 reviews), but NOT available for the dates and rules say large parties/events not allowed.
